env-title-bar.report: TitleBar is gone: a TopBar with titleBar is the window's title bar, .env-top-bar[data-title-bar], with the parts env-top-bar-start, env-top-bar-title and env-top-bar-actions.

env-window-frame.report: WindowFrame is gone: a window that draws its title bar is a Scaffold, env-scaffold, with data-top-bar-span="full", and its title bar a TopBar, .env-top-bar[data-title-bar].

env-window-frame-title-bar-layout.report: The title bar's layout has no class in 1.0: a TopBar lays out env-top-bar-start, env-top-bar-title and env-top-bar-actions itself.
